findings.issue: The general result — the real Gaussian kernel `(a, b) ↦ exp (-(c * ‖a - b‖ ^ 2))` on a real inner-product space is positive semidefinite — is proved inline as `have hG` + `have e` inside `isAdmissible_golecBiernatWusthoff`, already specialized to the plane and to `c = Qs ^ 2 / 4`. Nothing of the dipole enters the argument, so the general fact is unavailable to any other consumer (the roadmap's Layer 5.6 MV covariance positivity is directed at the same `Matrix.PosSemidef` module: roadmap README lines 212-213, "used for the positive-definiteness of the S-matrix kernel in Layer 0.5 and of the MV covariance in Layer 5.6").

summary: Generality is mostly right after the earlier fix (the Icc lemma is general over the index type, map_re is general over RCLike with an arbitrary index type). Two items: IsAdmissible.apply_comm demands two visibly unused fields for a fact that follows from positive semidefiniteness alone, and the general real Gaussian-kernel positivity is proved inline inside the physics witness instead of being stated once.
